subject: Follow-up: committed-use pricing & startup incentive details
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@lumenai.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: pricing range & committed usage options

Hey Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Santiago and I found the latency/cost controls compelling. A couple quick asks coming out of our side so we can take this back to finance: 

- Can you give a target $/1M tokens range for hosted vs committed-use? Our CFO asked for a target unit cost we should aim for.
- What does Redwood’s startup program look like (credits, term discounts)?
- If we consider a 12- or 24-month committed-use arrangement, what are the typical minimums and discount bands (and any requirements for upfront payment or PO)?

For context: LumenAI is pre‑Series A; current monthly production is small but we project growth to ~100M tokens/month within 9–12 months if product-market fit holds. Budget-wise, finance gave a soft target of $120k for year one but are willing to stretch if the unit economics make sense.

I attached a short RFP with expected usage patterns. Would love a concise write-up we can drop into the procurement review.

Cheers,
Emma
Emma Li
Head of Product, LumenAI
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma@lumenai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing range & committed usage options

Hi Emma — great to meet you and Santiago today. Quick recap + next steps below.

Recap (post-call):
- LumenAI: current production small, forecast ~100M tokens/month in 9–12 months.
- Primary ask: a target $/1M tokens and what committed-use discounts + startup incentives look like.

Clarifying items before I give precise bands (can you confirm these?):
1) Is the 100M/month figure steady-state or peak? (we price committed bands off monthly committed quantity).
2) Any compliance requirements (VPC/on‑prem) or will hosted API be acceptable?
3) Do you need embeddings or only generation/chat? Embeddings are priced differently at scale.

Prelim answers (high level):
- Hosted list: list pricing sits above committed tiers; typical customers see meaningful savings with multi-month commits.
- Startup program: we run a program that can include credits and a first-year discount for qualifying companies (need basic company details and an investor check).
- Committed-use: we can model 12- and 24-month options — discounts scale with committed volume and term. I’ll loop in Marissa (sales lead) and Priyom (program ops) to prepare an initial pricing matrix.

If you can confirm the three clarifying points, I’ll push the draft pricing and a short mutual action plan (MAP) by tomorrow.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma@lumenai.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing range & committed usage options

Thanks Aditya — answers inline:
1) 100M/month is our expected steady-state within 9–12 months; first 3 months will be ~15–30M/month ramp.
2) Hosted API is fine; no VPC needed for now.
3) We’ll use both generation (chat) and dense embeddings for search; embeddings will be ~20% of token volume.

Additional details:
- We’re an early-stage company (pre‑Series A), headquartered in SF. Investors: Brightwater Ventures.
- Finance asked for a target unit cost in the $8–$12 per 1M tokens range (they know this is high-level and illustrative).

Outcome ask: please include 12- and 24-month committed scenarios and a clear example that shows run-rate cost at 30M, 60M, and 100M tokens/month, and any startup credit/first-year discounts.

I attached the RFP (rfp_lumen.pdf).

Cheers,
Emma
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma@lumenai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-19T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing range & committed usage options

Emma — thanks for the quick clarifications. Putting together a concise pricing matrix below (preliminary, finance will validate). I’m keeping the numbers simple so procurement can reason about run-rate.

Assumptions: hosted API, mixed workload (80% generation, 20% embeddings), steady-state = 100M tokens/month.

Illustrative unit economics (USD per 1M tokens):
- Hosted (no commit): $18 / 1M tokens
- 12-month commit (min 10M/month commitment tier): $10 / 1M tokens with a 10% early-payment/annual-pay uplift available
- 24-month commit (min 8M/month commitment tier): $8 / 1M tokens with a 5% additional volume discount at >50M/month

Example run-rate (monthly cost):
- 30M/month: 12-mo = $300 (30 * $10) -> $300 per 1M? Sorry, typo — numbers are per 1M tokens. Corrected below.
Corrected:
- 30M/month at $10/1M = $300
- 60M/month at $9/1M (example blended with >50M discount) = $540
- 100M/month at $8/1M (24-mo committed discount) = $800

Startup program:
- We have a qualifying track: one-time credit (up to $25k) + accelerated first-year discount (typically 20%) for companies that meet investor / team size criteria.

Commit mechanics & asks from finance:
- For committed-use pricing we require a signed order form with committed monthly token minimum and an invoice schedule (monthly or annual).
- 24-month deals often require a PO and a small non-refundable commitment deposit (applied to first invoice).

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll produce a one-page pricing matrix + MAP and a short example invoice structure for 12- and 24-month options and share by EOD today.
2) If the numbers look reasonable, we schedule a procurement call next week with your finance to walk through the PO/invoice flow.

Looping Marissa for margin check and Neha for finance sign-off on deposit/PO language.

Regards,
Aditya
From: Emma Li <emma@lumenai.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Santiago Morales <santiago@lumenai.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing range & committed usage options

Aditya — this is helpful. A couple quick asks before procurement:
- Can you send the one-pager and MAP as a PDF we can attach to the RFP?
- For the startup credit eligibility, I can share our cap table / investor doc privately — is that sufficient?
- If you can show the 12- and 24-month invoice blurb (deposit amount, refundability, payment terms) that would be ideal.

We’re interested in the 24-month example at $8/1M if the deposit/purchase flow is straightforward. Please send the materials and I’ll confirm a time for next-week procurement.

Thanks,
Emma

Attachment: rfp_lumen.pdf
